planets.name: Kepler-1869 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-1869 with a 1.72-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: Kepler-1869 c was found in 2023 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around Kepler-1869. Its orbit and size follow Q1-Q17 DR25 KOI Table's fit, the archive's default.
